lines.text: The root is Volv! Evolve, involve.
Did you know? Volv is Latin for roll.
Quick quiz! Which means into plus roll?

words.ex: The language has evolved over centuries.
The job involves a lot of travel.

publish.title: Volv root: evolve and involve
publish.value: Volv comes from Latin "volvere" (to roll, to turn). Words: evolve and involve. evolve = e + volve; involve = in + volve.
